sources.albedo: PROXY: LROC WAC 643 nm normalised reflectance (16 ppd), rescaled to a global mean of 0.12 (bolometric albedo)
sources.temperature_day: Diviner GCP daily max where downloaded (bands: 00n10n, 90s80s); elsewhere ESTIMATED 392 K x cos(lat)^0.25
sources.temperature_night: Diviner GCP nightly min > Diviner L3 regolith T at 00:30 > constant 95 K (|lat| <= 60)

steps: LOLA: int16 x 0.5 + 1737.4 km (label) - 1737.4 km = height; stats per 0.5 deg cell
WAC: float32 with attached label, ISIS nulls/negatives -> NaN, mean per cell, rescaled
Temperatures: GCP tbol (-9999 -> NaN) max over 10-14 h / min over 18-06 h; fall-backs flagged
HARMONIZED: DEM block-mean x2 -> 3.79 km pixels; slope at that baseline; roughness/relief over 3x3 px
